backend.description: llm (default): probe classifier_role via llm.request. decision: ask the active decision.provider one choice question.

classifier_role.description: Role from core.models used for the classifier probe. Required for backend: llm.

decision_instructions.description: Instructions for the decision backend's choice question.

role_descriptions.description: Per-candidate-role description shown to the decision provider.

min_confidence.description: Decision backend: don't cache picks below this confidence.

fallback_role.description: Candidate role used on cache miss while the cache warms.

candidate_roles.description: Cheapest-first list of candidate model roles the classifier may pick from.

prefix_chars.description: Number of input chars passed to the classifier.

cache_classification.description: Cache classifier verdicts by input prefix.
